name: Dinas Emrys
text: Dinas Emrys is the Welsh name for an ancient hill-fort standing beneath the southern skirts of Mount Snowdon in Gwynedd. The Welsh form Ambrosius's fort preserves the link to the late Romano-British leader Ambrosius Aurelianus. The site carries both Arthurian and other legendary associations. Dinas Emrys stands near the modern village of Beddgelert. Folklore later placed here the boy-prophet tale of the red and white dragons. See the Ambrosius entry for the wider Romano-British setting.

okr.objective: Dinas Emrys as the Gwynedd hill-fort linked to Ambrosius and Arthurian tradition.
